question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

IGNORANT
solution:
The correct answer is **"Learned" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Ignorant:**- not knowing about something.किसी बात से) अनजान, अनभिज्ञ
 
• **Learned:-** having a lot of know
